text:
Eve (docs): opened a tiny PR to fix the tracing-hook example and add a short migration note about kv key naming. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123
Diego (eng-obsv): saw it. what's changing in the example?
Eve (docs): we now recommend using `kv.key_prefix` (namespaced) in filters and show a fallback for older exports that used `kv_prefix`. also clarified cost attribution when prefixes are broad.
Priya (devex): can you paste the new snippet so i can validate in the console preview?
Eve (docs): pasted JS snippet:
```js
const metrics = await client.fetchDashboard({
  dashboardId: 'kv-summary',
  filters: { 'kv.key_prefix': 'user/' },
  includeCost: true
});
```
Han (sdk): note: TS/JS uses `includeCost` since v0.18; Python uses `include_cost_breakdown`. i'll add a cross-lang note in the PR.
Diego (eng-obsv): wording suggestion: "Broad prefix filters aggregate cost/latency by prefix value. To inspect per-key variance, enable sampled per-key traces."
Eve (docs): added that line and a migration bash snippet to convert old exports: `jq '.events[] |= (. + {"kv.key_prefix": .kv_prefix})' old.json > new.json`
bot-deploy: docs preview passed: https://deploy-preview.docs.redwood-inference.com/5123
Priya (devex): validated screenshots in PR. small UI quirk noted: empty text filter expands all groups; documented as "Empty prefix = show all".
Han (sdk): opened tiny SDK PR for snippet sync: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/320
Eve (docs): thanks all — i'll merge once SDK PR is in and preview updates. planning to ship in the next docs patch.
thread_summary: Short coordination for docs PR updating tracing-hook/dashboard examples to use kv.key_prefix, adding migration snippet, and syncing SDK snippets.
